  game_date: null

    embed-resources: true

    toc: false

execute:

```{r setup}
#| output: false
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

library(gt)
library(dplyr)

cache_path <- "data/pipeline_cache.rds"
cache_ok   <- file.exists(cache_path) &&
              difftime(Sys.time(), file.mtime(cache_path), units = "hours") < 12

if (cache_ok) {
  cache <- readRDS(cache_path)
  list2env(cache, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  rm(cache)
}

source("09_reporting/_report_helpers.R")
source("09_reporting/_deepdive_helpers.R")
source("09_reporting/_game_narrative_helpers.R")

gpk  <- as.integer(params$game_pk)
game <- game_context %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk)

away_team  <- game$away_team_name
home_team  <- game$home_team_name
matchup    <- sprintf("%s @ %s", away_team, home_team)
game_label <- format(as.Date(params$game_date), "%A, %B %d, %Y")

away_sp_name <- tryCatch({
  r <- starter_matchup %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk, side == "away")
  if (nrow(r) > 0) dplyr::coalesce(r$pitcher_name[1], "TBD") else "TBD"
}, error = function(e) "TBD")

home_sp_name <- tryCatch({
  r <- starter_matchup %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk, side == "home")
  if (nrow(r) > 0) dplyr::coalesce(r$pitcher_name[1], "TBD") else "TBD"
}, error = function(e) "TBD")
```

```{r helper-defs, include=FALSE}
.ic <- function(lbl, val) {
  paste0('<div class="info-cell"><div class="lbl">', lbl,
         '</div><div class="val">', val, '</div></div>')
}

.pred_cell <- function(lbl, val) {
  paste0('<div class="pred-cell"><div class="lbl">', lbl,
         '</div><div class="val">', val, '</div></div>')
}

.ref_row <- function(stat, val) {
  paste0('<div class="ref-row"><span class="ref-stat">', stat,
         '</span><span class="ref-val">', val, '</span></div>')
}

make_lineup_print_gt <- function(gpk, side_filter) {
  tryCatch({
    game <- game_context %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk)
    team <- if (side_filter == "home") game$home_team_name else game$away_team_name

    opp_sp <- if (side_filter == "away") {
      r <- starter_matchup %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk, side == "home")
      if (nrow(r) > 0) dplyr::coalesce(r$pitcher_name[1], "Home SP") else "Home SP"
    } else {
      r <- starter_matchup %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk, side == "away")
      if (nrow(r) > 0) dplyr::coalesce(r$pitcher_name[1], "Away SP") else "Away SP"
    }

    stats_yr <- if (exists("offense_master_season") && nrow(offense_master_season) > 0)
      unique(offense_master_season$season)[1] else as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))

    full_stats <- offense_master_season %>%
      dplyr::arrange(mlbam_id, dplyr::desc(dplyr::coalesce(mlb_pa, 0L))) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(mlbam_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

    raw <- lineup_context %>%
      dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk, side == side_filter) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(batting_slot) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(full_stats, by = "mlbam_id", suffix = c("", "_dup")) %>%
      dplyr::select(-dplyr::ends_with("_dup"))

    if (nrow(raw) == 0) return(NULL)

    col1 <- function(df, cands) {
      found <- intersect(cands, names(df))
      if (length(found) == 0) rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)) else df[[found[1]]]
    }

    display <- dplyr::tibble(
      `#`    = raw$batting_slot,
      Name   = raw$player_name,
      Pos    = raw$fg_position,
      PA     = dplyr::coalesce(raw$mlb_pa, NA_integer_),
      HR     = dplyr::coalesce(raw$mlb_hr, NA_integer_),
      RBI    = dplyr::coalesce(raw$mlb_rbi, NA_integer_),
      `wRC+` = col1(raw, c("fg_wRC_plus", "fg_wRC.")),
      wOBA   = col1(raw, c("fg_wOBA")),
      AVG    = col1(raw, c("mlb_avg", "fg_AVG")),
      OBP    = col1(raw, c("mlb_obp", "fg_OBP")),
      SLG    = col1(raw, c("mlb_slg", "fg_SLG")),
      `BB%`  = col1(raw, c("fg_BB_pct", "fg_BB.")),
      `K%`   = col1(raw, c("fg_K_pct",  "fg_K."))
    )

    display %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::tab_header(
        title    = gt::md(paste0("**", team, "**")),
        subtitle = paste0("vs ", opp_sp, " \u00b7 ", stats_yr, " season")
      ) %>%
      gt::fmt_integer(columns = dplyr::any_of(c("PA", "HR", "RBI", "wRC+"))) %>%
      gt::fmt_number(columns  = dplyr::any_of(c("wOBA", "AVG", "OBP", "SLG")), decimals = 3) %>%
      gt::fmt_percent(columns = dplyr::any_of(c("BB%", "K%")), decimals = 1) %>%
      gt::fmt_missing(columns = dplyr::everything(), missing_text = "\u2014") %>%
      gt::tab_spanner(label = "Counting",   columns = dplyr::any_of(c("HR", "RBI"))) %>%
      gt::tab_spanner(label = "Core",       columns = dplyr::any_of(c("wRC+", "wOBA"))) %>%
      gt::tab_spanner(label = "Slash",      columns = dplyr::any_of(c("AVG", "OBP", "SLG"))) %>%
      gt::tab_spanner(label = "Approach",   columns = dplyr::any_of(c("BB%", "K%"))) %>%
      {
        tbl <- .
        vals <- display[["wRC+"]]
        if (sum(!is.na(vals) & is.finite(vals)) >= 2)
          tbl <- tbl %>% gt::data_color(
            columns = "wRC+",
            palette = c("#f8d7da", "#f8f9fa", "#d4edda"),
            domain  = c(70, 140), na_color = "white"
          )
        tbl
      } %>%
      gt::cols_width(`#` ~ gt::px(24), Pos ~ gt::px(32)) %>%
      gt::tab_options(
        table.font.size           = 10,
        heading.align             = "left",
        data_row.padding          = gt::px(3),
        column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
        table.width               = gt::pct(100)
      ) %>%
      gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")

  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Prediction data comes from make_prediction_data() in _game_narrative_helpers.R
# (single source of truth — same model as the prediction page)
```

```{r page1-header}
#| output: asis

# Build compact info cells — use isTRUE(!is.na()) everywhere so NULL columns don't crash
.g <- function(col) { v <- game[[col]]; if (length(v) == 0) NA else v[1] }

time_str    <- if (isTRUE(!is.na(.g("game_time")))) .g("game_time") else "TBD"
venue_str   <- dplyr::coalesce(game$venue_name[1], "—")
weather_str <- if (isTRUE(!is.na(.g("game_temp_f"))))    paste0(.g("game_temp_f"), "\u00b0F") else "—"
wind_str    <- if (isTRUE(!is.na(.g("wind_speed_mph")))) {
  dir_part <- if (isTRUE(!is.na(.g("wind_direction")))) paste0(", ", .g("wind_direction")) else ""
  paste0(.g("wind_speed_mph"), " mph", dir_part)
} else "—"
umpire_str  <- dplyr::coalesce(game$home_plate_umpire[1], "TBD")
series_str  <- if (isTRUE(!is.na(.g("game_in_series"))) && isTRUE(!is.na(.g("series_length")))) {
  flags <- c(
    if (isTRUE(game$is_series_opener[1])) "Series Opener",
    if (isTRUE(game$is_series_finale[1])) "Series Finale",
    if (isTRUE(game$is_rubber_match[1]))  "Rubber Match"
  )
  lbl <- paste0("Game ", .g("game_in_series"), " of ", .g("series_length"))
  if (length(flags) > 0) paste0(lbl, " \u2014 ", flags[1]) else lbl
} else "—"
type_flags  <- c(
  if (isTRUE(game$is_interleague[1]))   "Interleague",
  if (isTRUE(game$is_division_game[1])) "Division Game",
  if (isTRUE(game$is_doubleheader[1]))  "Doubleheader"
)
type_str <- if (length(type_flags) > 0) paste(type_flags, collapse = " \u00b7 ") else "League Game"

cat(paste0(
  '<div class="print-header no-break">',
  '<h1>', away_team, ' @ ', home_team, '</h1>',
  '<div class="sub">', game_label,
  ' &nbsp;\u00b7&nbsp; ', away_sp_name, ' vs ', home_sp_name,
  '</div>',
  '</div>',

  # Info grid — 4 columns × 2 rows
  '<div class="info-grid no-break">',

  .ic("First Pitch", time_str),
  .ic("Venue",       venue_str),
  .ic("Weather",     weather_str),
  .ic("Wind",        wind_str),
  .ic("HP Umpire",   umpire_str),
  .ic("Series",      series_str),
  .ic("Game Type",   type_str),

  '</div>'
))
```

```{r projection-section}
#| output: asis
tryCatch({
  pred_raw <- make_prediction_data(gpk)
  if (!is.null(pred_raw)) {
    away_runs <- sprintf("%.1f", pred_raw$away_runs)
    home_runs <- sprintf("%.1f", pred_raw$home_runs)
    total     <- sprintf("%.1f", pred_raw$away_runs + pred_raw$home_runs)
    away_pct  <- sprintf("%.0f%%", pred_raw$away_win_pct * 100)
    home_pct  <- sprintf("%.0f%%", pred_raw$home_win_pct * 100)

    cat(paste0(
      '<div class="print-h2">Game Projection</div>',
      '<div class="pred-row no-break">',
      .pred_cell(paste0(away_team, " Runs"),  away_runs),
      .pred_cell(paste0(home_team, " Runs"),  home_runs),
      .pred_cell("Total",                     total),
      .pred_cell(paste0(away_team, " Win%"),  away_pct),
      .pred_cell(paste0(home_team, " Win%"),  home_pct),
      '</div>'
    ))
  }
}, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))
```

```{r pitchers-section}
#| output: asis
cat('<div class="print-h2">Starting Pitchers</div>\n')

# Pitch arsenal compact list
tryCatch({
  if (exists("pitcher_arsenal") && nrow(pitcher_arsenal) > 0) {
    sm_rows <- starter_matchup %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk)
    if (nrow(sm_rows) > 0) {
      arsenal_lines <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(sm_rows)), function(i) {
        sp <- sm_rows[i, ]
        sp_id   <- sp$mlbam_id[1]
        sp_name <- dplyr::coalesce(sp$pitcher_name[1], "SP")
        ars <- pitcher_arsenal %>%
          dplyr::filter(mlbam_id == sp_id) %>%
          dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(dplyr::coalesce(usage_pct, 0))) %>%
          dplyr::slice_head(n = 4)
        if (nrow(ars) == 0) return("")
        pitch_str <- paste(
          vapply(seq_len(nrow(ars)), function(j) {
            pname <- dplyr::coalesce(ars$pitch_type[j], ars$pitch_name[j], "?")
            upct  <- ars$usage_pct[j]
            if (!is.na(upct)) paste0(pname, " (", round(upct * 100), "%)")
            else pname
          }, character(1)),
          collapse = ", "
        )
        paste0("<strong>", sp_name, ":</strong> ", pitch_str)
      }, character(1))
      arsenal_lines <- arsenal_lines[nchar(arsenal_lines) > 0]
      if (length(arsenal_lines) > 0) {
        cat(paste0(
          '<p style="font-size:10pt; margin:4pt 0 6pt 0; color:#333;">',
          paste(arsenal_lines, collapse = " &nbsp;|&nbsp; "),
          '</p>\n'
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}, error = function(e) invisible(NULL))

sp_tbl <- tryCatch(make_starter_gt(gpk, compact = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(sp_tbl)) {
```
